metrics.brier: sum of three squared errors, range 0–2
metrics.score: native modal and native top3; no inferred archived predictions
metrics.calibration: 10 fixed equal width bins, classwise and macro ECE

uncertainty.method: paired season × ISO-week cluster bootstrap, stratified by season; exploratory, not independent-match inference

retrospective_gate.decision: descriptive gate only; no promotion even if passed

prospective.horizon: 24h before scheduled kickoff; common immutable cutoff; reject late/missing timestamps; report missing coverage and fallback
prospective.candidate: competitive only, same versioned algorithm and feature contract; freeze coefficients/config/hashes before first enrolled kickoff, training strictly earlier
prospective.stop_rule: single locked assessment after at least 100 matches and 10 weeks, no optional stopping, continue to season end if criteria inconclusive; any changed model starts a new cohort
prospective.promotion: separate express authorization, E12 certification, rights, operations, rollback, no activation on retrospective evidence
prospective.current_status: not started; E09/E12 integration and real timestamps pending

ablation.combined_leave_one_group_out: same complete-case training and testing cohort; no lowering minimum n=100
